reading.title: Talking About a Family Photo
reading.text: Nadia shows a new colleague a family photo on her phone. She points to her mother and father, then introduces her sister and brother. She also explains which people are her parents and siblings and mentions that one relative has a baby. The conversation stays simple and friendly, helping the colleague understand who each person is.

reading.title: Planning a Family Weekend
reading.text: A family is planning a weekend together. The youngest child wants game night, while the middle child suggests a movie night and the only child from another household joins the visit. Their stepmother and stepfather help organize a family dinner and a short road trip. Everyone also plans a family photo before the weekend ends.

reading.title: Supporting Each Other
reading.text: Strong family relationships often grow through love, trust, support, and care. Adults may offer protection and guidance when someone faces a difficult decision. Affection can strengthen a bond, while fair discipline helps set clear limits. Families may also share stories, traditions, and heritage that connect younger and older generations. over time.
